title.narrative: SPVO – Empowering smallholder women in shea production in Northern Ghana

description.narrative: Shea nut production is a vital economic activity in northern Ghana, particularly for women who rely on it as a primary source of income. Despite its importance, the current shea value chain faces numerous challenges. Women producers are subjected to unfair pricing practices, delayed payments, and limited transparency, which results in them receiving a minimal share of the final product value. Social sustainability risks are also prevalent, including child labour issues driven by poverty, safety risks during shea collection and processing, and the ongoing loss of shea parklands due to deforestation and unsustainable practices.The beneficiaries of this project are primarily the women shea farmers who will gain improved income, improved working conditions, and greater market access. The project will also focus on removing child labour. By addressing structural issues in the shea value chain, their livelihoods can be stabilised, reducing poverty and promoting economic independence.The envisioned impact of the project is a sustainable, transparent, and equitable shea value chain. Sommalife Impact Group, in partnership with Solidaridad West Africa and Fairfood, employs a two-phase approach:• Phase A involves research and analysis to identify critical challenges in the industry and effective solutions.• Phase B focuses on implementing these solutions, including capacity building, traceability software features, near field communication (NFC) cards, pricing strategies.This strategic intervention will empower women by improving their incomes, addressing safety risks, and increasing transparency. Furthermore, by aligning with growing European demand for ethically sourced products and upcoming regulations like the Europrean Unio Regulation on Deforestation-free Products (EUDR) and the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), this project aims to future-proof the shea industry, contributing to both social and environmental sustainability.
